welcome_page.title: E-scooter – Your trips
welcome_page.description:
A few questions about getting around by e-scooter, your own or a shared one. If you rarely ride one, we only ask why.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: Do you ride an e-scooter to get around at least once a week?
questions.help: Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mopeds and seated scooters don't count here.

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: Why do you rarely ride an e-scooter? (Select all that apply)

options.text: I don't have an e-scooter I can use
The places I go are too far or it takes too long
Standing and keeping my balance on it is tiring or difficult for me
I feel unsafe riding one (traffic, crime or harassment)
There are no good cycle lanes or places to leave it
Another reason

questions.text: Which e-scooter do you use most often?

options.text: My own e-scooter
A shared e-scooter

questions.text: How confident do you feel riding an e-scooter in city traffic?

options.text: Not at all: I avoid riding in traffic
Not very: I ride in traffic only when I have to
In between
Fairly: I manage most situations
Very: I ride in any traffic
I never ride in traffic

questions.text: In the same trip, do you usually combine the e-scooter with another way of travelling?
questions.help: For example e-scooter and train, or e-scooter and metro. A short walk to a stop or to a parked vehicle does not count.

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: Which other ways of travelling do you use in the same trip? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Walking (as the main mode for most of the trip, not short access or transfer walking)
Car
Car sharing
Motorcycle, scooter or moped
Bus
Tram
Metro
Regional or suburban train
Bicycle/e-bike (private)
Bicycle/e-bike (shared)
Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bolt)

questions.text: What difficulties do you experience when combining different transport modes (e.g. bike + public transport, car + metro, walking + bus)?

options.text: Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space for a bicycle or luggage)
Poor coordination between modes (long waiting times, missed connections)
Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle parking or no bicycle access on public transport)
Complicated transfers (stations far apart, unclear routes)
Travel time becomes too long
Cost is too high when combining modes
Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe areas)
Services are infrequent or do not run in the evening
Lack of reliable information (schedules, delays)
Physical effort is too high (e.g. carrying a bicycle or walking long distances)
Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevators, etc.)
Weather-related difficulties
I do not experience significant difficulties

questions.text: When you face these difficulties, how do you mostly respond?

options.text: I stop using one of the modes (e.g. stop bringing my bike)
I switch to a single mode (e.g. only car, only public transport)
I change the time of travel (e.g. avoid peak hours)
I change the route or transfer point
I choose a different combination of modes
I continue using the same combination despite difficulties
I reduce how often I make that trip
I look for alternative solutions (e.g. bike sharing instead of own bike)
I avoid that trip entirely if possible
I do not experience significant difficulties

it.#<p>A few questions about getting around:
Qualche domanda su come ti sposti in monopattino elettrico, tuo o in condivisione. Se ne usi uno raramente, ti chiediamo solo perché.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Vai in monopattino elettrico almeno una volta a settimana per spostarti?
it.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Il tuo monopattino o uno in condivisione. Motorini e scooter con sella qui non contano.
it.#Which e-scooter do you use most often?: Quale monopattino elettrico usi più spesso?
it.#How confident do you feel riding an e-s: Quanta fiducia hai nell’andare in monopattino elettrico nel traffico cittadino?
it.#Not at all: I avoid riding in traffic: Per niente: evito di andare nel traffico
it.#Not very: I ride in traffic only when I: Poca: vado nel traffico solo quando devo
it.#Fairly: I manage most situations: Abbastanza: me la cavo nella maggior parte dei casi
it.#In the same trip, do you usually combin: Nello stesso spostamento, di solito oltre al monopattino usi anche un altro modo di spostarti?
it.#For example e-scooter and train, or e-s: Per esempio monopattino e treno, oppure monopattino e metro. Un breve tratto a piedi fino alla fermata o al veicolo parcheggiato non conta.
it.#Which other ways of travelling do you u: Quali altri modi di spostarti usi nello stesso spostamento? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#Walking (as the main mode for most of t: A piedi (come modalità principale per la maggior parte dello spostamento, esclusi brevi tratti di accesso o trasferimento)
it.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi o auto con conducente (NCC, ad es. Uber, Bolt)
it.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Quali difficoltà incontri nel combinare diversi mezzi di trasporto (ad es. bicicletta + trasporto pubblico, auto + metro, a piedi + autobus)?
it.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: I mezzi sono troppo affollati (ad es. non c'è spazio per la bicicletta o i bagagli)
it.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Scarso coordinamento tra i mezzi (lunghi tempi di attesa, coincidenze perse)
it.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Mancanza di infrastrutture (ad es. parcheggi per biciclette o accesso delle biciclette al trasporto pubblico)
it.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Cambi complicati (stazioni distanti tra loro, percorsi poco chiari)
it.#Travel time becomes too long: Il tempo di viaggio diventa troppo lungo
it.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Il costo è troppo elevato quando si combinano più mezzi
it.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: Preoccupazioni per la sicurezza (traffico, furti, zone poco sicure)
it.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Le corse sono rare o assenti la sera
it.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: Lo sforzo fisico è troppo elevato (ad es. trasportare una bicicletta o camminare per lunghe distanze)
it.#Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevat: Problemi di accessibilità (scale, assenza di ascensori ecc.)
it.#When you face these difficulties, how d: Quando incontri queste difficoltà, come reagisci principalmente?
it.#I stop using one of the modes (e.g. sto: Smetto di utilizzare uno dei mezzi (ad es. non porto più la mia bicicletta)
it.#I switch to a single mode (e.g. only ca: Passo a un'unica modalità di trasporto (ad es. solo auto o solo trasporto pubblico)
it.#I change the time of travel (e.g. avoid: Cambio l'orario dello spostamento (ad es. evito le ore di punta)
it.#I change the route or transfer point: Cambio il percorso o il punto di interscambio
it.#I choose a different combination of mod: Scelgo una diversa combinazione di mezzi
it.#I continue using the same combination d: Continuo a utilizzare la stessa combinazione nonostante le difficoltà
it.#I reduce how often I make that trip: Riduco la frequenza con cui effettuo quello spostamento
Cerco soluzioni alternative (ad es. bici in condivisione invece della mia bicicletta)
it.#I avoid that trip entirely if possible: Evito completamente quello spostamento, se possibile
it.#Why do you rarely ride an e-scooter? (S: Perché vai poco in monopattino elettrico? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#I don't have an e-scooter I can use: Non ho un monopattino elettrico da usare
it.#The places I go are too far or it takes: I posti dove vado sono troppo lontani o ci vuole troppo tempo
it.#Standing and keeping my balance on it i: Stare in piedi e mantenere l’equilibrio è faticoso o difficile per me
it.#I feel unsafe riding one (traffic, crim: In monopattino non mi sento al sicuro (traffico, criminalità o molestie)
it.#There are no good cycle lanes or places: Mancano buone piste ciclabili o posti dove lasciarlo

fr.#<p>A few questions about getting around:
Quelques questions sur vos déplacements en trottinette électrique, la vôtre ou en libre-service. Si vous en utilisez rarement une, nous demandons seulement pourquoi.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom. Indiquer votre adresse e-mail est facultatif ; les informations sur la protection des données de SmartUrbanity expliquent comment elle est protégée et comment vos réponses sont utilisées.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#How you ride an e-scooter: Comment vous utilisez la trottinette électrique
fr.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Utilisez-vous une trottinette électrique pour vous déplacer au moins une fois par semaine ?
fr.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: La vôtre ou une en libre-service. Les cyclomoteurs et scooters à selle ne comptent pas ici.
fr.#Which e-scooter do you use most often?: Quelle trottinette électrique utilisez-vous le plus souvent ?
fr.#How confident do you feel riding an e-s: Quelle confiance avez-vous quand vous roulez en trottinette électrique dans la circulation en ville ?
fr.#Not at all: I avoid riding in traffic: Aucune : j’évite de rouler dans la circulation
fr.#Not very: I ride in traffic only when I: Peu : je roule dans la circulation seulement quand je dois
fr.#Fairly: I manage most situations: Assez : je me débrouille dans la plupart des situations
fr.#Very: I ride in any traffic: Beaucoup : je roule dans toute circulation
fr.#I never ride in traffic: Je ne roule jamais dans la circulation
fr.#In the same trip, do you usually combin: Au cours d’un même trajet, combinez-vous généralement la trottinette électrique avec un autre mode de déplacement ?
fr.#For example e-scooter and train, or e-s: Par exemple trottinette électrique et train, ou trottinette électrique et métro. Une courte marche jusqu’à un arrêt ou à un véhicule garé ne compte pas.
fr.#Which other ways of travelling do you u: Quels autres modes de déplacement utilisez-vous au cours du même trajet ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#Walking (as the main mode for most of t: Marche (comme mode principal sur la plus grande partie du trajet, pas seulement pour rejoindre un autre mode ou faire une correspondance)
fr.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi ou service similaire (par ex. Uber, Bolt)
fr.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Quelles difficultés rencontrez-vous lorsque vous combinez différents modes de transport, par exemple vélo + transports publics, voiture + métro ou marche + bus ?
fr.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: Les véhicules sont trop remplis (par ex. pas de place pour un vélo ou des bagages)
fr.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Mauvaise coordination entre les modes (longues attentes, correspondances manquées)
fr.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Manque d’infrastructures (par ex. pas de stationnement vélo ou vélo non autorisé dans les transports publics)
fr.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Correspondances compliquées (stations éloignées, itinéraires peu clairs)
fr.#Travel time becomes too long: Le temps de trajet devient trop long
fr.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Le coût est trop élevé quand plusieurs modes sont combinés
fr.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: Problèmes de sécurité (trafic, vol, zones peu sûres)
fr.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Les passages sont rares ou inexistants le soir
fr.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: L’effort physique est trop important (par ex. porter un vélo ou marcher longtemps)
fr.#I do not experience significant difficu: Je ne rencontre pas de difficulté importante
fr.#When you face these difficulties, how d: Quand vous rencontrez ces difficultés, que faites-vous le plus souvent ?
fr.#I stop using one of the modes (e.g. sto: J’arrête d’utiliser l’un des modes (par ex. je ne prends plus mon vélo)
fr.#I switch to a single mode (e.g. only ca: Je passe à un seul mode de transport (par ex. uniquement la voiture ou uniquement les transports publics)
fr.#I change the time of travel (e.g. avoid: Je change mon heure de déplacement (par ex. j’évite les heures de pointe)
fr.#I change the route or transfer point: Je change d’itinéraire ou de lieu de correspondance
fr.#I choose a different combination of mod: Je choisis une autre combinaison de modes
fr.#I continue using the same combination d: Je continue à utiliser la même combinaison malgré les difficultés
fr.#I reduce how often I make that trip: Je fais ce trajet moins souvent
Je cherche une autre solution (par ex. vélo partagé au lieu de mon propre vélo)
fr.#I avoid that trip entirely if possible: J’évite complètement ce trajet si c’est possible
fr.#Why do you rarely ride an e-scooter? (S: Pourquoi utilisez-vous rarement une trottinette électrique ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#I don't have an e-scooter I can use: Je n’ai pas de trottinette électrique à disposition
fr.#The places I go are too far or it takes: Les lieux où je vais sont trop loin ou le trajet prend trop de temps
fr.#Standing and keeping my balance on it i: Rester debout et garder l’équilibre dessus est fatigant ou difficile pour moi
fr.#I feel unsafe riding one (traffic, crim: Je ne me sens pas en sécurité en trottinette (circulation, délinquance ou harcèlement)
fr.#There are no good cycle lanes or places: Il manque de bonnes pistes cyclables ou d’endroits où la laisser

de.#<p>A few questions about getting around:
Ein paar Fragen dazu, wie Sie mit dem E-Scooter unterwegs sind, mit einem eigenen oder einem geliehenen. Wenn Sie selten E-Scooter fahren, fragen wir nur nach dem Grund.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und Sie können jede Frage überspringen. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Die Angabe Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse ist freiwillig; die Datenschutzhinweise von SmartUrbanity erklären, wie sie geschützt wird und wie Ihre Antworten verwendet werden.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Fahren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche mit dem E-Scooter, um irgendwohin zu kommen?
de.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Ihr eigener E-Scooter oder ein geliehener. Mopeds und Motorroller mit Sitz zählen hier nicht.
de.#Which e-scooter do you use most often?: Welchen E-Scooter nutzen Sie am häufigsten?
de.#How confident do you feel riding an e-s: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich beim E-Scooter-Fahren im Stadtverkehr?
de.#Not at all: I avoid riding in traffic: Gar nicht: Ich vermeide es, im Verkehr zu fahren
de.#Not very: I ride in traffic only when I: Wenig: Ich fahre nur im Verkehr, wenn ich muss
de.#Fairly: I manage most situations: Einigermaßen: Ich komme in den meisten Situationen zurecht
de.#Very: I ride in any traffic: Sehr: Ich fahre in jedem Verkehr
de.#In the same trip, do you usually combin: Kombinieren Sie auf demselben Weg den E-Scooter meist mit einer anderen Art der Fortbewegung?
de.#For example e-scooter and train, or e-s: Zum Beispiel E-Scooter und Zug oder E-Scooter und U-Bahn. Ein kurzer Fußweg zur Haltestelle oder zum geparkten Fahrzeug zählt nicht.
de.#Which other ways of travelling do you u: Welche anderen Verkehrsmittel nutzen Sie auf demselben Weg? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#Walking (as the main mode for most of t: Zu Fuß (als Hauptverkehrsmittel für den größten Teil des Weges, nicht nur für kurze Zuwege oder Umstiege)
de.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi oder ähnlicher Fahrdienst (z. B. Uber, Bolt)
de.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Welche Schwierigkeiten haben Sie, wenn Sie verschiedene Verkehrsmittel kombinieren, zum Beispiel Fahrrad + öffentlicher Verkehr, Auto + U-Bahn oder zu Fuß + Bus?
de.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: Die Fahrzeuge sind zu voll (z. B. kein Platz für Fahrrad oder Gepäck)
de.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Schlechte Abstimmung zwischen Verkehrsmitteln (lange Wartezeiten, verpasste Anschlüsse)
de.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Fehlende Infrastruktur (z. B. keine Fahrradabstellplätze oder Fahrräder dürfen nicht mitgenommen werden)
de.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Kompliziertes Umsteigen (Haltestellen weit auseinander, unklare Wege)
de.#Travel time becomes too long: Die gesamte Fahrzeit wird zu lang
de.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Die Kosten sind beim Kombinieren mehrerer Verkehrsmittel zu hoch
de.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Die Verbindungen sind selten oder fahren abends nicht
de.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: Der körperliche Aufwand ist zu hoch (z. B. Fahrrad tragen oder lange Strecken zu Fuß gehen)
de.#Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevat: Probleme mit der Barrierefreiheit (Treppen, keine Aufzüge usw.)
de.#When you face these difficulties, how d: Wie reagieren Sie normalerweise, wenn diese Schwierigkeiten auftreten?
de.#I stop using one of the modes (e.g. sto: Ich nutze eines der Verkehrsmittel nicht mehr (z. B. nehme ich mein Fahrrad nicht mehr mit)
de.#I switch to a single mode (e.g. only ca: Ich wechsle zu nur einem Verkehrsmittel (z. B. nur Auto oder nur öffentlicher Verkehr)
de.#I change the time of travel (e.g. avoid: Ich ändere meine Fahrzeit (z. B. vermeide ich Stoßzeiten)
de.#I choose a different combination of mod: Ich wähle eine andere Kombination von Verkehrsmitteln
de.#I continue using the same combination d: Ich nutze trotz der Schwierigkeiten weiterhin dieselbe Kombination
Ich suche nach einer anderen Lösung (z. B. Leihrad statt eigenes Fahrrad)
de.#I avoid that trip entirely if possible: Ich vermeide diesen Weg ganz, wenn es möglich ist
de.#Why do you rarely ride an e-scooter? (S: Warum fahren Sie selten E-Scooter? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#I don't have an e-scooter I can use: Ich habe keinen E-Scooter, den ich nutzen kann
de.#The places I go are too far or it takes: Meine Ziele sind zu weit entfernt oder der Weg damit dauert zu lange
de.#Standing and keeping my balance on it i: Darauf zu stehen und das Gleichgewicht zu halten ist für mich anstrengend oder schwierig

tr.#<p>A few questions about getting around:
Kendi elektrikli scooter'ınız veya paylaşımlı bir elektrikli scooter ile ulaşım hakkında birkaç soru. Nadiren elektrikli scooter kullanıyorsanız yalnızca nedenini soruyoruz.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. E-posta adresi vermek isteğe bağlıdır; SmartUrbanity gizlilik bildirimi bunun nasıl korunduğunu ve yanıtların nasıl kullanıldığını açıklar.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Haftada en az bir kez elektrikli scooter ile yolculuk ediyor musunuz?
tr.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Kendi elektrikli scooter'ınız veya paylaşımlı bir elektrikli scooter. Mopedler ve oturaklı scooterlar burada sayılmaz.
tr.#Which e-scooter do you use most often?: En sık hangi elektrikli scooter'ı kullanıyorsunuz?
tr.#How confident do you feel riding an e-s: Şehir trafiğinde elektrikli scooter kullanırken kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Not at all: I avoid riding in traffic: Hiç değil: Trafikte scooter kullanmaktan kaçınırım
tr.#Not very: I ride in traffic only when I: Pek değil: Trafikte yalnızca zorunluysam scooter kullanırım
tr.#In the same trip, do you usually combin: Aynı yolculukta elektrikli scooter'ı genellikle başka bir ulaşım şekliyle birleştiriyor musunuz?
tr.#For example e-scooter and train, or e-s: Örneğin elektrikli scooter ve tren ya da elektrikli scooter ve metro. Durağa veya park edilmiş araca kısa bir yürüyüş sayılmaz.

fa.#<p>A few questions about getting around:
چند پرسش دربارهٔ رفت‌وآمد با اسکوتر برقی، چه شخصی و چه اشتراکی. اگر کم با اسکوتر برقی می‌روید، فقط علتش را می‌پرسیم.

شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه است و می‌توانید به هر پرسشی پاسخ ندهید. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شوند. وارد کردن ایمیل اختیاری است؛ بیانیه حریم خصوصی SmartUrbanity توضیح می‌دهد ایمیل چگونه محافظت می‌شود و پاسخ‌ها چگونه استفاده می‌شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#How you ride an e-scooter: شیوهٔ استفادهٔ شما از اسکوتر برقی
fa.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: آیا حداقل هفته‌ای یک بار برای رفت‌وآمد از اسکوتر برقی استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: اسکوتر برقی شخصی یا اشتراکی. موتور گازی و اسکوترهای صندلی‌دار اینجا حساب نمی‌شوند.
fa.#Which e-scooter do you use most often?: بیشتر از کدام نوع اسکوتر برقی استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#How confident do you feel riding an e-s: در ترافیک شهر با اسکوتر برقی چقدر احساس اطمینان می‌کنید؟
fa.#Not at all: I avoid riding in traffic: اصلاً: از اسکوترسواری در ترافیک دوری می‌کنم
fa.#Not very: I ride in traffic only when I: زیاد نه: فقط وقتی مجبورم در ترافیک اسکوترسوار می‌شوم
fa.#Fairly: I manage most situations: نسبتاً: از پس بیشتر موقعیت‌ها برمی‌آیم
fa.#Very: I ride in any traffic: بسیار: در هر ترافیکی اسکوترسوار می‌شوم
fa.#In the same trip, do you usually combin: آیا معمولاً در یک سفر، اسکوتر برقی را با روش دیگری از رفت‌وآمد ترکیب می‌کنید؟
fa.#For example e-scooter and train, or e-s: مثلاً اسکوتر برقی و قطار، یا اسکوتر برقی و مترو. پیاده‌روی کوتاه تا ایستگاه یا تا وسیلهٔ پارک‌شده حساب نمی‌شود.
fa.#Which other ways of travelling do you u: در همان سفر از کدام روش‌های دیگر رفت‌وآمد استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Walking (as the main mode for most of t: پیاده‌روی (به‌عنوان روش اصلی در بیشتر مسیر، نه فقط پیاده‌روی کوتاه برای رسیدن به وسیلهٔ دیگر یا تعویض وسیله)
fa.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: تاکسی یا خدمات مشابه (مثلاً Uber، Bolt)
fa.#What difficulties do you experience whe: هنگام ترکیب روش‌های مختلف رفت‌وآمد، مثلاً دوچرخه + حمل‌ونقل عمومی، خودرو + مترو یا پیاده‌روی + اتوبوس، با چه مشکلاتی روبه‌رو می‌شوید؟
fa.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: وسیله‌ها خیلی شلوغ هستند (مثلاً جا برای دوچرخه یا بار وجود ندارد)
fa.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: هماهنگی بین روش‌ها ضعیف است (انتظار طولانی، از دست دادن وسیله بعدی)
fa.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: زیرساخت کافی نیست (مثلاً پارک دوچرخه وجود ندارد یا بردن دوچرخه در حمل‌ونقل عمومی ممکن نیست)
fa.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: تعویض وسیله پیچیده است (ایستگاه‌ها از هم دورند، مسیرها نامشخص‌اند)
fa.#Travel time becomes too long: زمان کل سفر خیلی طولانی می‌شود
fa.#Cost is too high when combining modes: هزینه ترکیب چند روش خیلی زیاد است
fa.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: نگرانی‌های ایمنی و امنیتی (ترافیک، سرقت، مناطق ناامن)
fa.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: سرویس‌ها کم‌تعدادند یا عصرها و شب‌ها کار نمی‌کنند
fa.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: تلاش جسمی خیلی زیاد است (مثلاً حمل دوچرخه یا پیاده‌روی طولانی)
fa.#Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevat: مشکلات دسترس‌پذیری (پله، نبود آسانسور و غیره)
fa.#When you face these difficulties, how d: وقتی با این مشکلات روبه‌رو می‌شوید معمولاً چه کار می‌کنید؟
fa.#I stop using one of the modes (e.g. sto: استفاده از یکی از روش‌ها را کنار می‌گذارم (مثلاً دیگر دوچرخه‌ام را نمی‌برم)
fa.#I switch to a single mode (e.g. only ca: فقط از یک روش استفاده می‌کنم (مثلاً فقط خودرو یا فقط حمل‌ونقل عمومی)
fa.#I change the time of travel (e.g. avoid: زمان سفر را تغییر می‌دهم (مثلاً از ساعت شلوغی دوری می‌کنم)
fa.#I change the route or transfer point: مسیر یا محل تعویض وسیله را تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#I choose a different combination of mod: ترکیب دیگری از روش‌های رفت‌وآمد را انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I continue using the same combination d: با وجود مشکلات، همان ترکیب را ادامه می‌دهم
fa.#I reduce how often I make that trip: آن سفر را کمتر انجام می‌دهم
راه دیگری پیدا می‌کنم (مثلاً به جای دوچرخه شخصی از دوچرخه اشتراکی استفاده می‌کنم)
fa.#I avoid that trip entirely if possible: اگر ممکن باشد آن سفر را انجام نمی‌دهم
fa.#Why do you rarely ride an e-scooter? (S: چرا به‌ندرت از اسکوتر برقی استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#The places I go are too far or it takes: جاهایی که می‌روم خیلی دورند یا زمان زیادی می‌برد
fa.#Standing and keeping my balance on it i: ایستادن و حفظ تعادل روی آن برای من خسته‌کننده یا دشوار است
fa.#I feel unsafe riding one (traffic, crim: هنگام استفاده از آن احساس ناامنی می‌کنم (ترافیک، جرم یا آزار)
fa.#There are no good cycle lanes or places: مسیر دوچرخه مناسب یا جای مناسب برای گذاشتن آن وجود ندارد

hu.#<p>A few questions about getting around:
Néhány kérdés arról, hogyan közlekedik elektromos rollerrel – akár a sajátjával, akár megosztottal. Ha ritkán rollerezik, csak az okát kérdezzük.

A részvétel önkéntes, és bármelyik kérdést kihagyhatja. Válaszai nem kapcsolódnak a nevéhez. Az e-mail-cím megadása nem kötelező; a SmartUrbanity adatvédelmi tájékoztatója leírja, hogyan védjük az e-mail-címét, és hogyan használjuk fel a válaszokat.

További információ a SmartUrbanity projektről
hu.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Válaszát rögzítettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt a kérdőív kitöltésére.
hu.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Használ elektromos rollert a közlekedéshez legalább hetente egyszer?
hu.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Saját vagy megosztott elektromos roller. A segédmotoros kerékpárok és az ülős robogók itt nem számítanak.
hu.#Which e-scooter do you use most often?: Melyik elektromos rollert használja a leggyakrabban?
hu.#How confident do you feel riding an e-s: Mennyire magabiztos, amikor a városi forgalomban elektromos rollerrel közlekedik?
hu.#Not at all: I avoid riding in traffic: Egyáltalán nem: kerülöm a forgalomban való rollerezést
hu.#Not very: I ride in traffic only when I: Nem nagyon: csak akkor rollerezem a forgalomban, ha muszáj
hu.#In the same trip, do you usually combin: Ugyanazon az úton az elektromos rollert általában más közlekedési móddal kombinálja?
hu.#For example e-scooter and train, or e-s: Például elektromos roller és vonat, vagy elektromos roller és metró. A megállóig vagy a parkoló járműig tartó rövid gyaloglás nem számít.
hu.#Which other ways of travelling do you u: Milyen más közlekedési módokat használ ugyanazon az úton? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)

hu.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi vagy hasonló szolgáltatás (pl. Uber, Bolt)
hu.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Milyen nehézségeket tapasztal különböző közlekedési módok kombinálásakor, például kerékpár + tömegközlekedés, autó + metró vagy gyaloglás + busz?
hu.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: A járművek túl zsúfoltak (pl. nincs hely kerékpárnak vagy csomagnak)
hu.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Gyenge az összehangolás a közlekedési módok között (hosszú várakozás, lekésett csatlakozás)
hu.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Hiányos az infrastruktúra (pl. nincs kerékpárparkoló, vagy nem lehet kerékpárt vinni a tömegközlekedési járművekre)
hu.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Bonyolult az átszállás (az állomások messze vannak egymástól, az útvonalak nem egyértelműek)
hu.#Travel time becomes too long: Az utazási idő túl hosszú lesz
hu.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Túl magas a költség több közlekedési mód kombinálásakor
hu.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: Biztonsági problémák (forgalom, lopás, nem biztonságos területek)
hu.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Ritkán járnak a járatok, vagy este nem közlekednek
hu.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: Túl nagy a fizikai megterhelés (pl. kerékpár cipelése vagy hosszú gyaloglás)
hu.#When you face these difficulties, how d: Mit tesz általában, amikor ilyen nehézségekkel találkozik?
hu.#I stop using one of the modes (e.g. sto: Abbahagyom az egyik közlekedési mód használatát (pl. nem viszem magammal a kerékpárt)
hu.#I switch to a single mode (e.g. only ca: Egyetlen közlekedési módra váltok (pl. csak autó vagy csak tömegközlekedés)
hu.#I change the time of travel (e.g. avoid: Megváltoztatom az utazás időpontját (pl. kerülöm a csúcsidőt)
hu.#I change the route or transfer point: Megváltoztatom az útvonalat vagy az átszállási pontot
hu.#I continue using the same combination d: A nehézségek ellenére ugyanazt a kombinációt használom
hu.#I reduce how often I make that trip: Ritkábban teszem meg azt az utat
Más megoldást keresek (pl. saját kerékpár helyett megosztott kerékpárt használok)
hu.#I avoid that trip entirely if possible: Ha lehet, teljesen elkerülöm azt az utat
hu.#Why do you rarely ride an e-scooter? (S: Miért közlekedik ritkán elektromos rollerrel? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#The places I go are too far or it takes: Az úti céljaim túl messze vannak, vagy túl sokáig tart az út
hu.#Standing and keeping my balance on it i: A rolleren állni és egyensúlyozni fárasztó vagy nehéz számomra
hu.#I feel unsafe riding one (traffic, crim: Rollerezés közben nem érzem magam biztonságban (forgalom, bűncselekmények vagy zaklatás)
hu.#There are no good cycle lanes or places: Nincsenek jó kerékpársávok vagy olyan helyek, ahol le lehet állítani

ar.#<p>A few questions about getting around:
بعض الأسئلة عن التنقل بالسكوتر الكهربائي، الخاص أو المشترك. إذا كنت نادرًا ما تركبه، فنسألك فقط عن السبب.

المشاركة طوعية ويمكنك تخطي أي سؤال. لا ترتبط إجاباتك باسمك. إدخال البريد الإلكتروني اختياري؛ يوضح إشعار الخصوصية الخاص بـ SmartUrbanity كيف يُحمى وكيف تُستخدم الإجابات.
